strategies.name: Fast Fifty
strategies.myth: If it's at 50% in five minutes, it's sending.
strategies.rule: Buy any coin that hits 50% bonding in under 5 minutes.

strategies.name: Final Stretch
strategies.rule: Buy every coin the moment it crosses 90% bonding.

strategies.name: Graduation Chase
strategies.rule: Buy in the first 90 seconds after a coin migrates.

strategies.name: Fat Dev Bag
strategies.myth: A dev who buys big believes.
strategies.rule: Buy at launch when the dev takes 5% or more of the supply.

strategies.name: Holder Rush
strategies.myth: A hundred holders in ten minutes can't be faked.
strategies.rule: Buy when a coin passes 100 holders in its first 10 minutes.

strategies.name: Clean Top 10
strategies.rule: Buy at 40% bonding if the top 10 wallets hold under 20%.

strategies.name: Full Socials
strategies.myth: Real teams launch with X, site and Telegram.
strategies.rule: Buy at 25% bonding if the coin launched with X, a website and Telegram.

strategies.name: First Dip
strategies.rule: After a coin touches 40% bonding, buy its first 30% drop from the high.

strategies.name: Short Ticker
strategies.rule: Buy tickers of 4 letters or fewer that reach 25% within 10 minutes.

strategies.name: Volume Over Cap
strategies.myth: When volume beats market cap, it's early.
strategies.rule: Buy when 5-minute volume is bigger than the market cap, under 30 minutes old.

strategies.name: Buyers Two to One
strategies.myth: Twice the buys means it's going up.
strategies.rule: Buy at 30% bonding when buys beat sells 2 to 1 over 5 minutes (20+ buys).

strategies.name: Slow Burn
strategies.rule: Buy coins that take 30 minutes or more to reach 50% bonding.
